title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad
english: President Trump has cancelled plans to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. While the execution will still proceed by firing squad as scheduled, the president noted that many people expressed concerns about making the event public. The families of the victims will still be permitted to attend the execution in person to witness the final judgment.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በ2009 የፎርት ሁድ ጥቃትን ፈፅመዋል በተባሉት የቀድሞ የጦር ኃይሎች የሥነ-አእምሮ ባለሙያ ኒዳል ሃሳን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን የሞት ቅጣት በኢንተርኔት በቀጥታ ለማስተላለፍ የነበረውን ዕቅድ ሰርዘዋል። የሞት ቅጣቱ እንደተያዘለት በጠመንጃ መተኮስ (firing squad) የሚፈጸም ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በይፋ መታየቱ ብዙዎችን ስላሳሰበ እንዲሰረዝ ተወስኗል። ሆኖም የተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች ፍትህን በአካል ተገኝተው የመመልከት መብት ይኖራቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp ajjeechaa bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Foort Huuditti raawwatameef itti gaafatamaa kan ta'an, hayyuu sammuu waraanaa duraanii Nidaal Haasaan ajjeesisuuf qophiin ture haqaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun akka karooraatti rasaasaan kan raawwatamu ta'us, dhimmichi ifatti akka hin darbine namoota hedduun mormii waan kaasaniif haalichaa jijjiirameera. Ta'us, maatiin namoota miidhamanii sirnicharratti argamanii murticha ijaan arguuf mirga akka qaban ibsameera.

title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
english: A tragic school roof collapse in Peshawar, Pakistan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 33 students and one teacher. The incident occurred when a top-floor classroom ceiling gave way, causing a chain reaction that destroyed floors below and trapped many children. Authorities have arrested the school's owner and are currently investigating whether the building's construction violated safety standards.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ፔሻዋር ከተማ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት ጣራ በመውደቁ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 33 ተማሪዎች እና አንድ መምህር ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው የላይኛው ፎቅ ጣራ በመፍረሱና በታችኛው ክፍል የነበሩትን ወለሎች በመጫኑ በርካታ ተማሪዎች ፍርስራሽ ስር እንዲቀበሩ በማድረጉ ነው። የትምህርት ቤቱ ባለቤት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ሕንፃው የደህንነት መስፈርቶችን አሟልቶ የተሰራ መሆኑን ለማጣራት ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ነው።
oromo: Magaala Peshawaar kan biyya Paakistaanitti mana barnootaa tokko keessatti cinaan suufii kufuun isaa barattoota 33 fi barsiisaa tokko lubbuun akka darban taasiseera. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo suufiin kutaawwan barnootaa olii caccabee kufu, dachaa gaditti argamanis waliin jeeqee ijoollee hedduu jala galcheedha. Abbaan mana barnootichaa qabamanii jiru; akkasumas ijaarsi mana barnootichaa seera nageenyaa eeggatee kan ijaarame ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa irratti qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Syrian court sentences two to death over 2025 coastal violence
english: A Syrian court in Aleppo has issued death sentences to two former Bashar al-Assad supporters for inciting sectarian violence during an uprising in early 2025. Additionally, the court sentenced members of the new government’s security forces to prison terms for their involvement in the killings and torture of Alawite civilians. These rulings stem from a government investigation into the deaths of over 1,400 people during attacks in coastal regions last year.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 መጀመሪያ ላይ በተከሰተው አመጽ የሃይማኖት ግጭትን በማነሳሳት የቀድሞው የአሳድ መንግስት ደጋፊ የሆኑ ሁለት ግለሰቦችን በሞት ቀጣ። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም የአሁኑ መንግስት የጸጥታ ሃይል አባላት በአላዊት ንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ በፈጸሙት ግድያ እና እንግልት የረጅም ጊዜ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። እነዚህ ፍርዶች ባለፈው ዓመት በሶሪያ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች ከ1,400 በላይ ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈውን ግጭት ለመመርመር በተቋቋመ ኮሚቴ ግኝት ላይ የተመሰረቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Mana murtii Sooriyaa magaalaa Halabitti argamu, bara 2025 jalqaba irratti jeequmsa amantii kakaasuu fi walitti bu'iinsa uumuu jechuun gartuu Bashaar al-Asaad duraanii lama irratti adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Kana malees, miseensonni humnoota nageenyaa mootummaa ammaa lammilee saba Alawite irratti ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwachuu isaaniitiin hidhaan cimaan itti murtaa'eera. Murteen kun qorannoo mootummaan bara darbe naannoo qarqara galaanaa Sooriyaatti namoota 1,400 ol ajjeesise irratti taasifame hordofee kan kenname dha.

title: French football body urges fans and students to keep politics out of stadiums
english: The French Football Federation's ethics committee has officially requested that fans and students refrain from bringing political protests into stadiums. This follows several instances where supporters displayed banners criticizing the police response to recent nationwide student demonstrations. Officials emphasize that sports should remain neutral, strictly prohibiting political symbols or messages to ensure stadiums serve as places for unity rather than conflict.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን የስነ-ምግባር ኮሚቴ ደጋፊዎች እና ተማሪዎች የፖለቲካ ተቃውሞዎችን ወደ ስታዲየም እንዳያመጡ አሳሰበ። ይህ ጥሪ የተላለፈው በቅርብ ጊዜ በሀገሪቱ በተካሄዱ የተማሪዎች ሰልፎች ላይ የፖሊስን አያያዝ የሚተቹ ባነሮች በስታዲየም ውስጥ መታየታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ባለስልጣናት ስፖርት ገለልተኛ መሆን እንዳለበት በመግለጽ፣ ስታዲየሞች ለፖለቲካ ግጭት ሳይሆን ለመዝናኛ የሚውሉበት ቦታ እንዲሆኑ ለማድረግ ማንኛውም አይነት የፖለቲካ መግለጫዎች የተከለከሉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni naamusa federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa Faransaayi, taphataafi barattoonni mormii siyaasaa gara istaadiyoomii akka hin geessine dhaame. Kunis erga taphattoonni mormii barattootaa biyyattii irratti poolisiin fudhate balaaleffatu agarsiisanii booda kan dhufedha. Qaamoleen mootummaa ispoortiin giddu-galeessa ta'uu akka qabu ibsuun, istaadiyoomiin bakka walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa utuu hin taane, bakka gammachuu ta'uu akka qabuuf mallattooleen siyaasaa kamuu akka hin dhiyaanne dhorkaniiru.

title: Delegates walk out as Israeli president addresses summit
english: Representatives from more than ten nations staged a protest by walking out during a speech by Israeli President Isaac Herzog at a summit in Azerbaijan. Diplomats from several countries, including Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan, exited the venue as he began his address. This collective action highlights the significant diplomatic tension surrounding Israel's recent military activities.
amharic: በአዘርባጃን በተካሄደ ስብሰባ ላይ የእስራኤሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ ንግግር እያደረጉ ሳለ ከ10 በላይ አገራት የተወከሉ ዲፕሎማቶች ተቃውሟቸውን በመግለጽ ከአዳራሹ ወጥተዋል። ከቱርክ፣ ከፓኪስታን፣ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ከኢራን እና ከሌሎች አገራት የተወከሉ ባለስልጣናት ንግግሩ ሲጀመር አዳራሹን ለቀው ወጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርቡ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት ጋር በተያያዘ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ajajoonni fi bakka bu'oonni biyyoota kudhan ol ta'an, walga'ii Azerbaajanitti gaggeeffamaa ture irratti pirezidaantii Israa'el Isaak Herzoog yommuu haasaa gochaa turanitti, mormii isaanii ibsuuf kutaa walga'ii sana gadi dhiisanii ba'aniiru. Biyyoonni akka Turkii, Paakistaan, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Iraan kanneen keessatti argaman yommuu haasaan kun jalqabamu bakka walga'ichaa gadhiisanii ba'aniiru. Gochi kun haala waraana Israa'el waliin walqabatee dippilomaasii idil-addunyaa irratti dhiibbaan jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russian jet-powered drone hits supermarket in Ukraine’s Odesa
english: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a supermarket in the Odesa region of Ukraine on Thursday. The attack resulted in at least four injuries and caused a large fire at the scene. Ukrainian officials reported the incident as part of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በዩክሬን ኦዴሳ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኝ አንድ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ የሩሲያ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን ጥቃት አድርሷል። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎችን ያቆሰለ ሲሆን በቦታው ላይ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ ድርጊት አሁን እየተካሄደ ካለው የጦርነት ሂደት አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa darbe, xiyyaarri qunxurruu (drone) kan Raashiyaa, magaalaa Odesa kan biyya Yuukireen keessatti suuqii tokko rukuteera. Miidhaan kun namoota afur ol irratti miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera akkasumas ibidda cimaa uumeera. Aangoonni Yuukireen akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun waraana ammaa geggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan dhalate dha.

title: US teen held over Hindu temple attack plot: Is anti-Indian racism rising?
english: A 19-year-old white supremacist from Illinois, Alexandros Paporakis, was arrested for allegedly plotting a mass shooting at a Hindu temple. Prosecutors state he expressed hatred toward Indian people and other minority groups in a manifesto and had attempted to carry out an attack with a rifle. The suspect was taken into custody after his weapon malfunctioned and coworkers reported his threats to the police.
amharic: አሌክሳንድሮስ ፓፖራኪስ የተባለ የ19 ዓመት ወጣት በኢሊኖይ ግዛት በሚገኝ የሂንዱ ቤተ መቅደስ ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም በማቀድ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ተጠርጣሪው በሕንድ ተወላጆች እና በሌሎች አናሳ ቡድኖች ላይ ጥላቻ እንደሚሰማው በሚገልጽ ጽሑፍ ውስጥ የጥቃት ዕቅዱን አዘጋጅቶ ነበር። መሣሪያው በመበላሸቱ ምክንያት ጥቃቱን ሳይፈጽም ቀርቶ፣ የሥራ ባልደረቦቹ ለፖሊስ ጥቆማ በመስጠታቸው በቁጥጥር ስር ሊውል ችሏል።
oromo: dargaggoon umriin isaa 19 kan ta’e fi ilaalcha 'white supremacist' qabu tokko, mana sagadaa Hindu tokkorratti weerara gaggeessuuf karoorfate ture jedhamee Illinois keessatti qabameera. Namni kun namoota Hinduu fi gareewwan biroo irratti jibba qabaachuusaa barreeffama inni qopheesse keessatti ibseera. Meeshaan inni itti fayyadamaa ture erga itti cufamee booda, hiriyyoonni hojiisaa poolisii beeksisuun isaa akka qabamu godhaniiru.

title: Ukraine to restart strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced that Ukraine will resume attacks on Russian oil refineries after a brief pause requested by the United States. Zelensky accused the U.S. of withdrawing critical intelligence and interfering with Starlink services to pressure Kyiv into stopping these strikes. Despite a proposed energy ceasefire, Ukraine claims Russia has continued to target its own power infrastructure, leading Zelensky to feel betrayed by American leadership.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጥያቄ መሰረት ለአጭር ጊዜ አቁመውት የነበረውን የሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ዘለንስኪ፣ አሜሪካ በኪቭ ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር ስትል የስለላ መረጃዎችን ማጋራቷን እንዳቆመች እና የስታርሊንክ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎትን እንደገደበች ከሰዋል። የቀረበውን የኢነርጂ ተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ሩሲያ ባለማክበሯ እና የዩክሬንን የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ማጥቃቷን በመቀጠሏ፣ ዘለንስኪ በአሜሪካ መንግስት እንደተከዱ ይሰማቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski, gaaffii Ameerikaatiin yeroo gabaabaaf dhaabamee ture, miidhaan buufataalee qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti gaggeeffamu akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Zeelenski, Ameerikaan Yukreen haleellaa kana akka dhaabdu dhiibbaa gochuuf jecha odeeffannoo basaasaa akka isaan dhorkatte fi tajaajila intarneetii Staarliinkis akka ittistee himataniiru. Walii galtee dhaabbii waraana fayyaa irratti biyyoonni lameen walii galuu baatanis, Raashiyaan buufataalee elektirikii Yukreen irratti haleellaa geggeessuu ishee kan itti fufte ta'uu fi kanaanis Zeelenski mootummaa Ameerikaan gatamuu akka itti dhaga'ame ibsaniiru.

title: Two dead in Istanbul after heaviest rainfall in 84 years, governor says
english: Istanbul recently experienced its most intense rainfall in 84 years, resulting in two fatalities and widespread flooding across the city. Authorities have evacuated nearly 600 stranded residents and have urged citizens to stay home as dangerous conditions persist. To ensure public safety, schools have been closed and administrative leave has been granted to certain government employees.
amharic: ኢስታንቡል በ84 ዓመታት ታሪኳ ከፍተኛውን የዝናብ መጠን በማስተናገዷ ምክንያት በደረሰው ጎርፍ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከጎርፍ የታደጉ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው አደገኛ በመሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ቤት እንዲቆዩ አሳስበዋል። ለሕዝብ ደህንነት ሲባል ትምህርት ቤቶች ተዘግተዋል እንዲሁም አንዳንድ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞች ፈቃድ እንዲወስዱ ተወስኗል።
oromo: ኢስታንቡል ባለፉት 84 ዓመታት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ከባድ ዝናብ ሳቢያ በተከሰተ ጎርፍ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከአደጋው የታደጉ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው አደገኛ በመሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ መክረዋል። ለሕዝብ ደህንነት ሲባል ትምህርት ቤቶች እንዲዘጉ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞችም የዕረፍት ፈቃድ እንዲወስዱ ተወስኗል።

title: Eight crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
english: A San Marino-flagged oil tanker named Wine Trader caught fire after being struck by drones off the coast of Romania, leaving eight of its 12 crew members missing. Authorities have launched a major rescue mission using helicopters and boats despite challenging weather conditions. This incident follows a similar recent attack near Bulgaria, prompting Romanian and Bulgarian leaders to discuss potential security consultations with NATO.
amharic: የሳን ማሪኖ ባንዲራ የሚውለበለብበት የነዳጅ ጫኝ መርከብ ሮማኒያ የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በድሮን ጥቃት ተመትቶ በእሳት በመያያዙ 12ቱ የሰራተኞች አባላት ስምንቱ የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም። አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ቢኖርም ባለስልጣናት በሄሊኮፕተር እና በጀልባዎች ታግዞ የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራ እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ጥቃት በቡልጋሪያ አቅራቢያ ከተፈጸመ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ የሮማኒያ እና የቡልጋሪያ መሪዎች ከኔቶ ጋር የጸጥታ ምክክር ለማድረግ እየመከሩ ነው።
oromo: Markaan boba'aa kan alaabaa San Maariino qabu kan Wine Trader jedhamu, daangaa biyya Roomeeniyaatti miidhamaa isaa erga haleelamee booda ibiddaan gubachuu isaa hordofee, hojjettoota 12 keessaa saddeet gadi ba'anii badaniiru. Haalli qilleensaa yoo rakkisaa ta'eyyuu, aanga'oonni helicopterootaafi dooniiwwan fayyadamuun hojii barbaachaafi baraarsa bal'aa jalqabaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan biyya Bulgaariyaatti muudate waliin wal fakkaatu waan ta'eef, hogganoonni Roomeeniyaafi Bulgaariyaa dhimma nageenyaa irratti NATO waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
english: The Brazilian Congress has passed a significant constitutional amendment to reduce the standard workweek from 44 to 40 hours while ensuring workers receive two days off without any reduction in pay. This major reform, supported by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is expected to benefit approximately 30 million employees and has received overwhelming public approval. Even opposition figures, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, eventually voted in favor of the measure, which is seen as a strategic political win shortly before the upcoming presidential runoff.
amharic: የብራዚል ፓርላማ የስራ ቀናትን በመቀነስ በሳምንት ውስጥ ከ44 ሰዓታት ወደ 40 ሰዓታት እንዲያድግ የሚያደርግ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ ህግ ሰራተኞች ደመወዛቸው ሳይቀንስ በሳምንት ሁለት ቀናት እረፍት እንዲያገኙ ያስችላቸዋል። በፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የተደገፈው ይህ ለውጥ ከ30 ሚሊዮን በላይ ለሚሆኑ ሰራተኞች ተጠቃሚ እንደሚያደርግ ይጠበቃል። በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ላይ ትልቅ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
oromo: Mana maree biyya Brazil hojjettoonni torbanitti sa’aatii 44 hojjechaa turan gara 40tti akka gad xiqqatu seerri jijjiiramee ragga’eera. Seerri haaraan kun hojjettoonni mindaan isaanii osoo hin hir’atin torbanitti guyyaa lama guutuu boqochuu akka danda’an taasisa. Pirezidaant Luwiiz Iinaasiyo Luula da Silvaa kan deggaran kun, hojjettoota miliyoona 30 ol ta’aniif fayyadamoo kan godhuufi jijjiirama guddaa ta’eera. Murtichi kun filannoo pirezidaantummaa kan dhufu keessatti shoora guddaa taphata jedhamee eegama.

title: US-Iran stalemate: What are Trump’s next military options?
english: President Donald Trump has promised to delay any military strikes against Iran until after the November midterm elections, despite rising tensions and increased Iranian attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Although the US maintains a significant military advantage, previous efforts have failed to secure the region or stabilize global energy prices, which have spiked due to the conflict. Military analysts are currently evaluating the potential risks and outcomes of various strategies the administration may pursue once the election period concludes.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ተከትሎ፣ ከህዳር ወር የአጋማሽ ምርጫ በፊት በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደማይሰነዝሩ አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አቅም ቢኖራትም፣ እስካሁን የተወሰዱ እርምጃዎች የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረትን ለመቆጣጠር ወይም በክልሉ ሰላም ለማስፈን አልቻሉም። የጦርነት ተንታኞች ምርጫው እንዳለቀ ትራምፕ ሊወስዷቸው ስለሚችሉ አማራጭ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እና ስለሚያስከትሉት ውጤት እየመከሩበት ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Tiraamp, naannoo waraana Hormuz keessatti waldhabdeen dabaluus isaa hordofee, filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa Sadaasaa dura Iran irratti haleellaa waraanaa akka hin banne dubbataniiru. Ameerikaan humna waraanaa cimaa qabaattus, tarkaanfiileen hanga ammaatti fudhataman gatii boba’aa tasgabbeessuuf ykn naannichatti nagaa buusuuf hin gargaarre. Xiinxaltoonni waraanaa, erga filannoon xumuramee booda Tiraamp tarkaanfii waraanaa akkamii fudhachuu akka danda'anfi bu'aa inni qabaachuu danda'u irratti gorsa kennaa jiru.

title: Syrian authorities arrest main suspect in 2013 Baniyas mass killings
english: Syrian authorities have captured Ali Kayali, also known as Mihrac Ural, who is the primary suspect in the 2013 mass killings in Baniyas and Bayda. He was detained by intelligence officials while attempting to flee across the border. Kayali previously commanded a pro-government militia during the Bashar al-Assad administration.
amharic: የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2013 በባኒያስ እና በባይዳ ከተሞች ለተፈጸመው የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ዋና ተጠርጣሪ የሆኑትን አሊ ካያሊን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው ድንበር አቋርጠው ለማምለጥ ሲሞክሩ በስለላ ድርጅት አባላት ተይዘዋል። ካያሊ የቀድሞው የሶሪያ መንግስትን ይደግፍ የነበረ ታጣቂ ቡድንን ይመሩ እንደነበር ይታወቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa namicha bara 2013 magaalaawwan Baaniyaas fi Baydaa keessatti ajjeechaa jumlaa raawwate jedhamee shakkamu, Alii Kaayaalii qabee jira. Namichi kun daangaa ce’ee baqachuuf yaalaa osoo jiruu humnoota basaasaatiin qabame. Kaayaaliin yeroo bulchiinsa Baashar al-Asaaditti garee waraanaa mootummaa deggaru hogganaa ture.

title: Fighting in Yemen intensifies: What’s the latest on the battlefield?
english: Violent conflict in Yemen has escalated as Houthi rebels and the Saudi-led coalition exchange frequent aerial attacks. The Houthis have intensified their targeting of Saudi oil facilities and airports, leading to casualties and significant infrastructure damage. This surge in fighting marks a breakdown of the 2022 ceasefire, with both sides engaged in a retaliatory cycle of military strikes.
amharic: በየመን ያለው ግጭት በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በሳዑዲ በሚመራው ጥምረት መካከል እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። ሁቲዎች በሳዑዲ የአየር ማረፊያዎች እና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ ያደረሱት ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትሏል። ይህ የተጠናከረ ጥቃት እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በመጣስ ሁለቱ ወገኖች የአጸፋ እርምጃቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru loltoota Huutii fi waldaa Saudiin durfamu gidduutti daran hammaatee jira. Huutiin buufataalee xiyyaaraa fi iddoowwan qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Saudi Arabaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miidhaan guddaanis qaqqabeera. Babal'achuu haleellaa kanaatiin waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2022 kahuun, gam lamaanuu walfalmii haleellaa ijaa baasuutti seenanii jiru.

title: FIFA set for rule change after Balogun red card row at the World Cup: reports
english: FIFA is planning to revise its disciplinary regulations following widespread criticism over the controversial decision to overturn a red card given to U.S. player Folarin Balogun. During the recent World Cup, political intervention led to the reversal of his automatic suspension, causing significant backlash from football officials and global experts. The FIFA council is now meeting to vote on a new rule that would officially prevent disciplinary committees from interfering with match-related suspensions in the future.
amharic: ፊፋ በአሜሪካዊው ተጫዋች ፎላሪን ባሎጉን ላይ የተሰጠውን ቀይ ካርድ በፖለቲካዊ ጣልቃገብነት በመሻሩ በተነሳው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ምክንያት የዲሲፕሊን ህጎቹን ለማሻሻል አቅዷል። በዓለም ዋንጫው ወቅት የተደረገው ይህ ውሳኔ በብዙ የֆეხ볼 ባለሙያዎችና አመራሮች ዘንድ ትልቅ ውዝግብ አስነስቶ ነበር። አሁን የፊፋ ምክር ቤት ቀይ ካርድ እና ተያያዥ ቅጣቶች ወደፊት በዲሲፕሊን ኮሚቴዎች እንዳይቀየሩ የሚከለክል አዲስ ህግ ላይ ለመምከር ተሰብስቧል።
oromo: FIFA taphataa Ameerikaa Folarin Balogun irratti kaartii diimaa kenname dhiibbaa siyaasaatiin haqamuusaatiin mormii guddaan mudachuu hordofee, seera isaa haaromsuuf karoorfateera. Murtiin kun tapha Waancaa Addunyaa irratti akka taphataan kun hinfirraanne taasisuunsaa, hoogganoota kubbaa miillaafi ogeeyyii hedduu biratti mormii kaasee ture. Amma koreen FIFA murtee kaartii diimaa fi adabbiiwwan walqabatan gara fuulduraatti koree disipliniin akka hinjijjiiramne dhowwu seera haaraa irratti mari'achuuf walga'eera.

title: Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia could be postponed by a year amid Houthi attacks
english: The 2027 Asian Cup scheduled to be held in Saudi Arabia may be delayed by one year due to ongoing security concerns and Houthi missile attacks. The Asian Football Confederation is currently monitoring the situation and plans to make a final decision by the end of November. While officials hope to keep the tournament on schedule, they are prepared to postpone the event to 2028 if regional instability continues to threaten participant safety.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የ2027 የእስያ ዋንጫ በሀገሪቱ ላይ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ የሁቲዎች ጥቃቶች እና የፀጥታ ስጋቶች ምክንያት በአንድ ዓመት ሊራዘም ይችላል። የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ሲሆን የመጨረሻ ውሳኔውን በኖቬምበር መጨረሻ ለማሳወቅ አቅዷል። ውድድሩ በተያዘለት ጊዜ እንዲካሄድ ቢፈለግም፣ የፀጥታው ሁኔታ ካልተሻሻለ ውድድሩን ወደ 2028 ለማዛወር ዝግጅት እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Qophiin Waancaa Eeshiyaa bara 2027 Saudii Arabiyaatti gaggeeffamuuf karoorfame, haleellaa garee Huutii fi dhimmoota nageenyaa biyyattii mudateen walqabatee waggaa tokkoof dabarfamuu danda'a. Koreen kubbaa miilaa Eeshiyaa haala yeroo hordofaa jiruufi dhuma ji'a Sadaasaa irratti murtoo xumuraa kan dabarsan ta'a. Taphoonni kunneen yeroo qabameefitti akka gaggeeffaman hawwu illee, rakkoon nageenyaa yoo itti fufe qophiin kun gara bara 2028tti dabarfamuuf qophiidha.

title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
english: A group of 72 retired high-ranking US military officers has urged the Pentagon to stop its plan to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan, the soldier responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. The retired officials argue that broadcasting the execution is a cruel act that would humiliate the military and potentially turn the perpetrator into a martyr for his extremist views. While some officials in the current administration are reconsidering the decision, President Trump has previously expressed support for the public broadcast.
amharic: የጡረታ የወጡ 72 ከፍተኛ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ወታደራዊ መኮንኖች፣ ፔንታጎን በፎርት ሁድ የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ፈጻሚው በኒዳል ሃሳን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት እንዳያስተላልፍ ጠይቀዋል። ጡረተኞቹ መኮንኖች ይህ ድርጊት ኢ-ሰብአዊ እና ለወታደራዊ ክብር የማይመጥን መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የቅጣቱ በቀጥታ መተላለፍ ወንጀለኛውን ሰማዕት አስመስሎ ሊያቀርብ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአስተዳደሩ ውስጥ ያሉ አንዳንድ አካላት በወሰኑት ላይ እንደገና እያሰቡ ቢሆንም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ለሃሳቡ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ቀደም ሲል ገልጸው ነበር።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Ameerikaa 72 ta'an kan hojiirraa ba'an, Pentagon guyyaa ajjeechaa Nidal Hasan kan bara 2009 Fort Hood irratti raawwatamee ture, sagantaa bilbilan (livestream) akka hin dabarsine gaafataniiru. Qondaalonni kunneen tarkaanfiin kun kan namummaarraa fagaatee fi ulfina waraanaa kan xureessuudha, akkasumas namichi kun akka gootaa akka ilaalamu gochuu danda'a jedhaniiru. Mootummaan Trump irratti yaada adda addaa kan qabu ta'us, hanga ammaatti murtiin dhumaa waan hin kennamneef, hogganoonni kunneen dhimma kana akka dhaaban dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: White House defends new press secretary amid questions about her legal credentials
english: The White House is supporting its new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, following public skepticism regarding her legal qualifications. While she claims to have practiced international law, reports indicate she never passed the bar exam necessary to be a licensed attorney in the United States. A watchdog group has now requested an investigation into whether she misled the public about her credentials.
amharic: የነጭ ቤተ መንግስት አዲሷ የፕሬስ ፀሐፊ ኬቲ ዘካሪያ የህግ ባለሙያ መሆኗን በተመለከተ ለተነሱ ጥያቄዎች ድጋፍ እየሰጠ ነው። ምንም እንኳን እርሷ በዓለም አቀፍ የህግ ዘርፍ እንደሰራች ብትናገርም፣ በአሜሪካ የህግ ባለሙያ ለመሆን የሚያስፈልገውን የፈቃድ ፈተና ማለፏ አልተረጋገጠም። አንድ የክትትል ቡድን እርሷ የህግ ባለሙያ መሆኗን በተመለከተ የውሸት መረጃ ሰጥታ ሊሆን ይችላል በሚል ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥያቄ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) kan ta'an gabaasaa fi dubbi-himaa haarawa isaanii Katie Zacharia irratti mormiin erga ka'ee booda, isheen ga'umsa akka qabdu ibsuun deggarsa kennaniiru. Zacharia seera idil-addunyaa irratti hojjettee akka turte kan dubbattu ta'us, biyya Ameerikaa keessatti abukaatummaan hojjechuuf qormaata barbaachisu darbuu ishee ragaan hin jiru. Gareen mirga namoomaa fi adeemsa sirrii hordofu tokko, isheen waa'ee guddina barnoota ishee irratti uummata gowwoomsuu ishee qorannoon akka mirkanaa'u gaafateera.

title: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns
english: Severe wildfires in Indonesia have caused a thick, hazardous orange smog to engulf the city of Palangka Raya. Pollution levels have spiked to four times the dangerous threshold, severely affecting residents and neighboring countries like Singapore and Malaysia. Authorities believe that agricultural slash-and-burn practices are a primary cause of this intense environmental crisis.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ በሚገኙ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ምክንያት የፓላንካ ራያ ከተማን ጥቅጥቅ ያለ አደገኛ ብርቱካናማ ጭስ አጥለቅልቋታል። የአየር ብክለት መጠኑ ከተፈቀደው አደገኛ ደረጃ በአራት እጥፍ በላይ በመጨመሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እና በአካባቢው ያሉ አገራትን እያማረረ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ከባድ የጭስ አደጋ ያደረሰው በዋናነት የእርሻ መሬትን ለማጽዳት የሚደረገው የደን ቃጠሎ ዘዴ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa Indoneesiyaatti ka’e hordofee, magaalaan Palangka Raya qilleensa cimaa fi bifaan isaa burtukaana’u ta’een ukkaamamee jira. Sadarkaan faalama qilleensaa daangaa balaa irraa dachaa afuriin ol waan darbeef, namoota miliyoonaan lakka’aman fi biyyoota ollaa akka Singappoor fi Maleeziyaatti rakkoo hamaa uumeera. Qaamoleen mootummaa balaa kanaaf sababa guddaan tooftaa qonnaa bosona gubanii lafa qopheessuu akka ta’e ibsaniiru.

title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
english: Finance ministers and central bank governors from G20 nations are meeting in Bangkok to discuss the global economic instability caused by the ongoing war involving Iran. The event is being held alongside annual World Bank and IMF meetings to address rising energy costs and uncertain financial outlooks. Despite the US currently holding the G20 presidency, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will not attend due to conflicting domestic obligations.
amharic: የG20 አባል ሀገራት የፋይናንስ ሚኒስትሮች እና የባንክ ገዥዎች በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት እየተፈጠረ ባለው ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ዙሪያ ለመምከር በባንኮክ ተገናኝተዋል። ስብሰባው ከአለም ባንክ እና ከዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) አመታዊ ጉባኤዎች ጋር በአንድ ላይ እየተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ በዋናነት የኃይል ዋጋ መናር እና የኢኮኖሚ አለመረጋጋትን ለመፍታት ያለመ ነው። የG20 ሊቀመንበር የሆነችው አሜሪካን በመወከል መገኘት የነበረባቸው የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት በአገር ውስጥ ጉዳዮች ምክንያት በስብሰባው ላይ እንደማይገኙ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Ministiroonni faayinaansii fi bulchitoonni baankiiwwan giddu galeessaa biyyoota G20 waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee dinagdee addunyaarratti dhiibbaa uumame mari'achuuf magaala Bangkokitti walga'aniiru. Walga'iin kun walga'ii waggaa Baankii Addunyaa fi IMF waliin kan adeemsifamaa jiru yoo ta'u, gatii anniisaa dabalaa jiru fi tasgabbii dhabuu dinagdee irratti xiyyeeffata. Yaa'ii kana kan hoogganaa jirtu Ameerikaan ta'us, ministirri faayinaansii ishee Scott Bessent dhimmoota biyya keessaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu qabaniin walqabatee walga'icha irra hin jiraatan.

title: Is Lamine Yamal’s Barcelona record better than Messi’s as a teenager?
english: Nineteen-year-old Lamine Yamal is currently outperforming Lionel Messi’s teenage statistics at Barcelona, recording 17 goal contributions in his first 10 games this season. While Messi managed 14 contributions during his first Ballon d'Or campaign at the same age, Yamal's performance has also slightly surpassed Kylian Mbappe’s early record. These impressive achievements have made Yamal a strong contender for the upcoming Ballon d'Or award.
amharic: የ19 ዓመቱ ላሚን ያማል በባርሴሎና ቤት ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት፣ በዘንድሮ የውድድር ዘመን በመጀመሪያዎቹ 10 ጨዋታዎች 17 ግቦችን በማስቆጠር እና በማቀበል የሊዮኔል ሜሲን በጉርምስና ዕድሜ የነበረውን ክብረ ወሰን በልጧል። ሜሲ በ19 ዓመቱ የመጀመሪያውን የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ሲያሸንፍ በነበረበት ወቅት 14 ግቦችን ብቻ ነበር የተሳተፈው። ያማል በአሁኑ ወቅት የፈረንሳዩን ኮከብ ኪሊያን ኤምባፔንም ቁጥር በትንሹ በመብለጡ፣ ለቀጣዩ የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ዋና ተፎካካሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Lammiin Yaamaal kan umuriin isaa waggaa 19 ta'e, barruu kana keessatti taphataa Baarseloonaa kan ta'e Lionel Messi umuriisaa dargaggummaa keessa qabu caalee argameera. Yaamaal taphoota 10 sadarkaa kilabii goolii 8 lakkoofsiisee fi 9 akka gumaachu ergeera, kunis riikordii Messi kan yeroo jalqabaaf Badhaasa Ballon d'Or mo'ate sana caala. Raawwiin Yaamaal kun kan Kylian Mbappe yeroo umuriin isaa 19 ture sanaa xiqqoo kan caalu ta'uun, badhaasa Ballon d'Or dhufuuf akka dorgomaa cimaatti akka fudhatamu isa taasiseera.

title: Restoring nature is key to a more resilient future
english: The rapid loss of nature is destabilizing our environment and threatening global food and water security. Scientists argue that we can reverse this damage by triggering positive changes in our energy, food, and financial systems. If we successfully transform these sectors, we can create a self-sustaining cycle of recovery that ensures a more resilient future for everyone.
amharic: የተፈጥሮ ሃብት በፍጥነት መመናመን ለአካባቢያችን መረጋጋት እና ለዓለም የምግብ እና የውሃ አቅርቦት ስጋት ሆኗል። ሳይንቲስቶች እንደሚሉት በኢነርጂ፣ በምግብ እና በፋይናንስ ሥርዓቶች ውስጥ አወንታዊ ለውጦችን በማምጣት ይህንን አደገኛ አካሄድ መቀልበስ ይቻላል። እነዚህን ዘርፎች በዘላቂነት ማሻሻል ከተቻለ፣ ለወደፊት የተሻለ እና ጠንካራ ማህበረሰብ መፍጠር የሚቻልበትን መንገድ መክፈት ይቻላል።
oromo: Hir’inni uumamaa saffisaan mul’atu kun miidhaa naannoo keenya irraan ga’uun dabalatee, nageenya nyaataa fi bishaan addunyaa irra sodaa guddaa buuseera. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, sirna anniisaa, nyaataa fi faayinaansii keenya keessatti jijjiirama gaarii fiduudhaan miidhaa kana furuun ni danda’ama. Yoo qooda fudhannoo qabatamaa sektaroota kana keessatti goone, gara fuulduraatti jireenya tasgabbaa’aa fi cimina qabu mirkaneessuu dandeenya.

title: Israel has detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since 2023: report
english: A report from the Palestinian Prisoner’s Society reveals that Israeli forces have detained over 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023. Currently, at least 350 of these minors are being held in Israeli jails, where they reportedly face severe mistreatment including abuse, starvation, and lack of medical care. Rights groups argue that these practices violate the children's basic rights and cause long-term harm to their health and stability.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እስረኞች ማህበር ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ እስራኤል ከ2,000 በላይ የፍልስጤም ህጻናትን ማሰሯን አስታውቋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ቢያንስ 350 የሚሆኑት ህጻናት በእስራኤል እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ በእስር ላይ ሳሉም ስቃይ፣ ረሃብ እና የህክምና እርዳታ ማጣትን ጨምሮ ከፍተኛ በደል እየደረሰባቸው መሆኑን ሪፖርቱ ያመለክታል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ድርጊት የህጻናትን መሰረታዊ መብቶች መጣስ እና በአካላዊና ስነ-ልቦናዊ ጤንነታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Palestinian Prisoner’s Society' akka ibsetti, Israa'el bara 2023 irraa eegalee ijoollee Palastinii 2,000 ol ta'an hidhuu ishee beeksiseera. Yeroo ammaa kana ijoolleen 350 ol ta'an mana hidhaa Israa'el keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, achittis dararaa, beela, fi gargaarsa yaala fayyaa dhabuu dabalatee miidhaa cimaaf saaxilamaa jiru. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa ibsuun, gochi kun mirga bu'uuraa ijoollee sarbuu fi fayyaa isaanii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jira jedhaniiru.

title: Heavy rain causes mass pileup in Brazil tunnel
english: Severe rainfall triggered a major multi-vehicle collision and significant flooding inside the Anhangabau tunnel in Sao Paulo, Brazil. The rising water trapped numerous commuters inside their vehicles, making it impossible for emergency responders to access the site immediately. Rescuers had to wait for the floodwaters to subside before they could safely reach the stranded individuals.
amharic: በብራዚል ሳኦ ፓውሎ በሚገኘው የአንሃንጋባው ዋሻ ውስጥ በጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በርካታ ተሽከርካሪዎች የተሳተፉበት አደጋ እና ጎርፍ ተከስቷል። ከፍተኛ የውኃ መጠን መንገዱን በመውረሩ አሽከርካሪዎች መውጫ አጥተው ተጠምደው ነበር። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ጎርፉ እስኪቀንስ ድረስ ወደ ስፍራው መድረስ ባለመቻላቸው የታሰሩትን ሰዎች ለመታደግ መጠበቅ ግድ ሆኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Biraazil magaalaa Saa'oo Paawuloo keessatti, rooba cimaa robeenisawwaniin lafarra jiru handaaraa Anhangabau keessatti balaan konkolaattoota hedduu walitti buusee fi lolaan hamaan uumameera. Bishaan bakka sana guute konkolaattoota keessa namoota hedduu qabee waan tureef, gareen gargaarsaa yeruma sana bakka balaa sana ga'uu hin dandeenye. Gargaartonni kunneen bishaanichi hir'atuuf obsaan eeguun dirqama ta'eera.

title: Trump suggests those who leak government information should ‘be shot’
english: During a campaign rally, Donald Trump stated that individuals who leak classified government information to the media deserve to be shot. He made these remarks while criticizing the exposure of sensitive military details regarding a 2025 attack on Iranian facilities. Trump accused news outlets and political opponents of endangering lives by sharing confidential intelligence.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ወቅት መንግሥታዊ ሚስጥሮችን ለዜና ማሰራጫዎች የሚያወጡ ሰዎች መገደል አለባቸው ሲሉ ተናግረዋል። ይህንን አስተያየት የሰጡት በ2025 በአሜሪካ እና በአይራን መካከል በተደረገው ግጭት ወቅት የተለቀቁ ሚስጥራዊ ወታደራዊ መረጃዎችን በመቃወም ነው። ትራምፕ እነዚህን መረጃዎች የሚያወጡ አካላት የሀገርን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ በመግለጽ ተቺዎቻቸውን ወቅሰዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump duula filannoo irratti akka ibsetti, odeeffannoo mootummaa icitii ta'e miidiyaatti kan baasan namoonni ajjeefamuu qabu jedheera. Yaada kana kan kenne, bara 2025 Iran irratti haleellaa raawwatame ilaalchisee odeeffannoon waraanaa dhimma icitiin qabamuu qabu ifa ba'uu isaa hordofee dha. Trump miidiyaaleefi morkattoota siyaasaa odeeffannoo kana gadhiisuun nageenya biyyattii balaaf saaxilaniiru jechuun komateera.

title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
english: Elon Musk has stated that the US government, rather than his company, is responsible for setting speed and usage restrictions on Starlink and Starshield services in Ukraine. Recent connectivity issues impacted Ukrainian drone operations, prompting calls from Kyiv for immediate restoration of full service. Musk clarified that his company provides civilian internet but relies on US military authorization for military-grade network operations.
amharic: ኢሎን ማስክ በዩክሬን ውስጥ የሚገኙት የስታርሊንክ እና የስታርሺልድ አገልግሎቶች ፍጥነትና የአጠቃቀም ገደቦች የተጣሉት በኩባንያው ሳይሆን በአሜሪካ መንግሥት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ የተከሰተው የግንኙነት መቋረጥ የዩክሬን የድሮን እንቅስቃሴዎችን በመጉዳቱ፣ ኪየቭ አገልግሎቱ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲመለስ ጥያቄ አቅርባለች። ማስክ አክለውም፣ ኩባንያቸው ሲቪል የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት እንደሚሰጥ ነገር ግን ወታደራዊ አገልግሎቶቹ በአሜሪካ ጦር ቁጥጥር ሥር መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Elon Musk tajaajilli Starlink fi Starshield biyya Yukreen keessatti daangeeffame murtee mootummaa Ameerikaa malee murtee dhaabbata isaa miti jedheera. Rakkoon quunnamtii dhiheenya kana mudate hojii dooniiwwan Yukreen irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, mootummaan Yukreen tajaajilichi akka guutummaatti deebi'u gaafatteetti. Musk ibsa isaan, dhaabbatichi tajaajila interneetii siivilii kan kennu yoo ta'u, hojiiwwan waraanaa garuu harka fi ajaja waraana Ameerikaa jala akka jiran beeksisaniiru.

title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
english: Thousands of students in Tirana, Albania, have engaged in violent anti-government protests, leading to attacks on several public buildings, including the Ministry of Education. Demonstrators are demanding improvements to university conditions and broader systemic change, citing high levels of government corruption and economic frustration. While authorities have deployed riot police to disperse the crowds with tear gas and water cannons, the opposition party has expressed support for the protesters' actions.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች በመንግስት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በበርካታ የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ተማሪዎቹ የዩኒቨርሲቲ ሁኔታዎች እንዲሻሻሉ እና በመንግስት ውስጥ ያለው ሙስና እንዲቆም በመጠየቅ ላይ ናቸው። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በረብሻው የተሳተፉ ሰዎችን ለመበተን የለቅሶ ማስታገሻ ጋዝ እና የውሃ መድፍ እየተጠቀሙ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት የህዝብ ንብረት ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት አውግዟል።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Albaniyaa Tiraanaatti barattoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman mormii mootummaa irratti qaban guyyaa lammaffaaf gaggeessaa jiru. Barattoonni kun haala barnootaa fooyyessuu fi malaammaltummaa mootummaa irratti mormii guddaa kaasaniiru; kana keessas manneen hojii mootummaa irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Poolisiin mormitoota bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansisuu fi bishaan humnaan gadi lakkisuu fayyadameera; mootummaan immoo gocha kana balaaleffateera.

title: Denmark pushes back as Trump touts Greenland oil and mineral deals
english: Denmark has clarified that a recent agreement with the United States and Greenland does not grant American companies special rights to extract natural resources. This response follows claims by President Trump suggesting that large-scale mining and drilling projects are about to commence on the island. Danish officials emphasized that the current deal focuses on military cooperation and defense, while strictly upholding Greenland’s sovereignty and existing environmental laws.
amharic: ዴንማርክ ከአሜሪካ እና ከግሪንላንድ ጋር የተፈራረመችው የቅርብ ጊዜ ስምምነት የአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች የተፈጥሮ ሃብቶችን ለመዝረፍ ልዩ መብት እንደማይሰጥ አስታውቃለች። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው በግሪንላንድ ግዙፍ የማዕድን እና የነዳጅ ማውጣት ስራዎች በቅርቡ ይጀመራሉ በማለት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሰጡት መግለጫ ነው። የዴንማርክ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ በዋናነት በወታደራዊ ትብብር ላይ ያተኮረ እንጂ፣ የግሪንላንድን ሉዓላዊነት እና የሃገር ውስጥ ህጎችን የሚጥስ አለመሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Denmaarkiin waliigaltee dhihoo kana Ameerikaa fi Gireenlaandii waliin mallatteessiteen, kampaniin Ameerikaa qabeenya uumamaa lafaa sanaa fayyadamuuf mirga addaa akka hin qabne ibsiteerti. Ibsi kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaant Traamp Gireenlaanditti hojiin albuudaa fi boba'aa baasuu dafee akka jalqabu dubbatanii boodadha. Hojiin mootummaan Denmaark akka ibsetti, waliigalteen kun kan xiyyeeffatu walta'iinsa waraanaa irratti malee, birmadummaa Gireenlaandii fi seera naannichaas kan hin cabsine ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: ICE pushes back on report suggesting body cameras that automatically record
english: The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency has formally rejected a recommendation from government auditors to implement body cameras that record automatically. While the Government Accountability Office suggested this technology to ensure transparency during unpredictable encounters, ICE officials cited privacy concerns as their primary reason for the refusal. This decision comes amidst increasing public scrutiny regarding the use of force by immigration agents during enforcement operations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ማስፈጸሚያ ኤጀንሲ (ICE)፣ የመንግስት ኦዲተሮች በድንገተኛ ሁኔታዎች በራስ-ሰር የሚቀዱ የሰውነት ካሜራዎችን እንዲጠቀሙ ያቀረቡትን ሃሳብ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የመንግስት ተጠያቂነት ቢሮ ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ግልጽነትን ለማስፈን እንደሚረዳ ቢጠቁምም፣ ኤጀንሲው የግለሰቦች የደህንነት ስጋት በመኖሩ ምክንያት ሀሳቡን አልቀበልም ብሏል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኤጀንሲው በስራው ወቅት ኃይልን ስለመጠንቀቁ እና ስለሚጠቀምባቸው ድርጊቶች እየተነሳ ባለው ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ መካከል የተወሰነ ነው።
oromo: Ejensiin Immigiresinii fi Gumurukii Amerikaa (ICE), gorsa qorattoonni mootummaa kaameraa qaamaa ofumaan sagalee fi suuraa kaasu fayyadamuuf dhiyeessan fudhachuu dideera. Waajjirri Itti Gaafatamummaa Mootummaa tekinolojiin kun yeroo haalli hin eegamne uumamutti iftoomina akka mirkaneessu ibsuus, ICE garuu dhimmi iccitii fi mirga dhunfaa sababoota ijoo ta'uun gorsa kana mormeera. Murteen kun kan dhufu, hojjettoonni immigiresinii kun hojii isaanii irratti humnaa fi tarkaanfii fudhataniin walqabatee komii fi mormii ummataa cimaa jiru gidduutti dha.

title: Real Madrid come from 3-1 down to beat Roma on Champions League travels
english: Real Madrid achieved a dramatic 4-3 comeback victory against Roma in their recent Champions League match. Despite trailing 3-1 late in the second half, the visitors scored three goals in seven minutes from corner kicks to secure the win. This result provides significant relief for Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho, who was returning to face his former club.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ በቅርቡ በተደረገ የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ሮማን 4 ለ 3 በሆነ አስደናቂ ውጤት አሸንፏል። ቡድኑ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ 3 ለ 1 ተሸንፎ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በመጨረሻዎቹ ደቂቃዎች በተገኙ ሶስት የኮርነር ኳሶች ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ድሉን መቀዳጀት ችሏል። ይህ ድል ወደ ቀድሞ ክለቡ የተመለሰው የሪያል ማድሪዱ አሰልጣኝ ሆሴ ሞሪንሆ ላይ የነበረውን ከፍተኛ ጫና የቀነሰ ነበር።
oromo: Ri'aal Maadriid tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii darbe keessatti Roma 4-3 injifachuun deebi'ee mo'ateera. Gareen kun walakkaa lammaffaa irratti 3-1 waan tureef, daqiiqaa torba keessatti kubbaa koornara irraa goolii sadii galchuun injifannoo argachuu danda'eera. Injifannoon kun leenjisaa Ri'aal Maadriid Josee Moriniihoo kan garee isaa duraanii irratti dhiyaatan irratti dhiibbaa ture salphiseera.

title: PSG beat Man City 4-2 in Champions League thriller
english: Paris Saint-Germain defeated Manchester City 4-2 in an exciting Champions League match held at the Etihad Stadium. PSG dominated the first half with three quick goals, and despite two goals from Erling Haaland for City, the visitors maintained their lead to secure the win. The match took place amidst ongoing pressure on Manchester City following recent rulings regarding their financial conduct.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመን በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ማንችስተር ሲቲን 4 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት አሸንፏል። የፈረንሳዩ ክለብ በጨዋታው የመጀመሪያ አጋማሽ ባስቆጠራቸው ሶስት ግቦች የበላይነቱን የወሰደ ሲሆን፣ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ለማንችስተር ሲቲ ሁለት ግቦችን ቢያስቆጥርም የፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመንን ድል ማስቀረት አልቻለም። ይህ ጨዋታ የተካሄደው ማንችስተር ሲቲ በገንዘብ ነክ ህግ ጥሰት ክስ በተመሰረተበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Paaris Saint-Jarmaan tapha Shaampiyoons Liigii irratti Maanchistar Siitii 4 fi 2 mo'ateera. Paaris Saint-Jarmaan walakkaa jalqabaa taphichaa goolii sadii galchuun dursuun isaa kan yaadatamu yoo ta'u, Erliing Haalaand Maanchistar Siitiif goolii lama galchulleen injifannoo Paaris Saint-Jarmaan dhaabsisuu hin dandeenye. Taphi kun kan taasifame yeroo Maanchistar Siitiin himannaa yakka maallaqaa wajjiin walqabatu keessa jiruutti dha.

title: Colombia opposition groups launch protest against de la Espriella’s cuts
english: Thousands of protesters led by former President Gustavo Petro took to the streets in Colombia to oppose the austerity measures and economic policies introduced by President Abelardo de la Espriella. The demonstrators fear that the new administration is dismantling essential social reforms and labour protections established by the previous government. In response to the protests, the government has authorized police to use stricter measures to prevent vandalism or the blockage of public services.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ የሚመሩት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች በፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪዬላ በመንግስት ወጪ ቅነሳ እና በኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ተቃውሞአቸውን አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ አዲሱ አስተዳደር የቀድሞው መንግስት የጀመራቸውን የማህበራዊ እና የሰራተኛ መብት ማሻሻያዎችን እየቀለበሰ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። መንግስት በበኩሉ ሰላማዊ ሰልፉን ሰበብ በማድረግ የህዝብ አገልግሎትን ለሚረብሹ ወይም ንብረት ለሚያወድሙ አካላት ላይ ጠንካራ የፖሊስ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hiriirri mormii pirezidaantii duraanii Gustaavoo Pirootroon durfamu, tarkaanfii dinagdee pirezidaantii ammaa Aabelaardoo de la Espireellaa mormuuf Kolombiyaatti geggeeffameera. Mormitoonni mootummaan ammaa kun jijjiiramoota hawaasummaa fi mirga hojjattootaa kanneen mootummaan darbe hojiirra oolchee ture diigaa jiraachuu isaatti yaadda'u. Mootummaan gamasaatiin, mormiin kun yoo qabeenya barbadeesse ykn tajaajila hawaasaa kan gufachiise ta'e, poolisiin tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu ajajeera.

title: Overthrowing Iran's government 'essential for Israel's security', Netanyahu says
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu asserts that removing the current Iranian government is vital for Israel's safety. While he claims Israeli actions have significantly weakened Iran and halted their nuclear progress, he admits that a regime change is unlikely before the upcoming October elections. Additionally, Netanyahu criticized his political opponents for not supporting his strategy to dismantle the Iranian leadership.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የኢራን መንግስትን መለወጥ ለእስራኤል ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ኢራንን በእጅጉ እንደዳከሟት እና የኑክሌር ፕሮግራሟን እንዳስተጓጎሉ ቢገልጹም፣ በጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ በፊት ለውጥ ይመጣል ብለው አያምኑም። በተጨማሪም፣ ኔታንያሁ የኢራን መንግስትን ለማስወገድ የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ የማይደግፉትን ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu mootummaan Iraan buqqifamuu qabaachuu isaa nageenya Israa'elitti fayyada jechuun ibsan. Tarkaanfiin Israa'el Iraan irratti fudhatte ishee dadhabsiisuu fi qophii niwuukilaraa ishee dhaabuu ishee kan himan ta'us, filannoo guraandhala dhufuun dura jijjiiramni ni dhufa jedhanii hin yaadan. Kana malees, Netanyaahu mormitoonni siyaasaa isaa yaada mootummaa Iraan diiguu kana waan hin deggerreef isaan cee'eera.

title: Houthis claim Saudi military aircraft 'struck directly' over Yemen airspace
english: Houthi forces have announced that they successfully hit a Saudi Arabian Eurofighter Typhoon military jet while it was flying over the Saada region in Yemen. A spokesperson for the group stated that the aircraft was critically damaged by an air-to-air missile and is likely to crash. However, Saudi officials and independent observers have not yet verified these claims or provided details regarding the incident.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ሳዳ ግዛት ላይ ሲበር የነበረ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ወታደራዊ ጀት በአየር ላይ መምታታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የቡድኑ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለፁት ጄቱ በአየር ላይ በተተኮሰ ሚሳይል ተመትቶ ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን ሊከሰከሰ እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ የሳዑዲ መንግስትም ሆነ ገለልተኛ አካላት ይህን ጥቃት በይፋ አላረጋገጡም።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa xiyyaarri waraana Saudi Arabiyaa tokko qilleensa naannoo Sa’adaa Yemen irratti balali'aa utuu jiruu rukutamuu isaa ibseera. Dubbi himaan garee kanaa akka jedhetti, xiyyaarichi misaa'elaan rukutamee miidha cimaa irra ga'ee jiraachuu fi kufuuf akka dhiyaate beekameera. Haa ta'u malee, hanga ammaatti mootummaan Saudi Arabiyaa ta'e madda walaba ta'een oduun kun dhugaa ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'uu hin dandeenye.

title: EU calls on Houthis to lift siege on Yemen’s Taiz
english: The European Union has urged Houthi forces to end their blockade of the Yemeni city of Taiz to facilitate the delivery of humanitarian relief. The organization emphasized the need to protect civilians and ensure that essential supplies can reach those in need. This call comes as the World Food Programme reports that residents in the city are facing severe food shortages.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ታኢዝ ከተማ ላይ የጣሉትን ከበባ በማንሳት የሰብአዊ እርዳታዎች እንዲገቡ ጥሪ አቅርቧል። ድርጅቱ የሲቪል ሰዎችን ደህንነት መጠበቅ እና አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶች ለተቸገሩት መድረስ እንዳለባቸው አሳስቧል። በዓለም የምግብ ፕሮግራም መረጃ መሰረት፣ በከተማዋ ያለው የምግብ እጥረት በጣም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa gareen Huutii magaalatti Ta’iz irra kaayee jiru akka kaasuufi gargaarsi namoomaa akka galu gaafateera. Dhaabbatichi lubbuu nagaa eeguufi meeshaaleen barbaachisoon namoota gargaarsa barbaadan bira akka ga’an cimsee hubachiiseera. Dhaabbanni Nyaata Addunyaa akka gabaasetti, magaalattii keessatti hanqinni nyaataa sadarkaa hamaa irra ga’ee jira.

title: Houthi strikes mark the end of Saudi Arabia's Yemen 'containment strategy'
english: Saudi Arabia’s attempt to manage the Houthi movement in Yemen through an uneasy truce has failed, presenting a major challenge for Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. After years of costly conflict and a subsequent period of passive containment, recent escalations suggest that the kingdom's efforts to keep the group in check have collapsed. Experts compare the Saudi approach to previous failed strategies of containment, noting that the kingdom can no longer rely on the existing status quo to maintain regional stability.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱትን ሁቲዎችን በስምምነት ለመገደብ ያደረገችው ጥረት በመከሸፉ ለልዑል አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማን ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ለዓመታት የዘለቀው ውድ ጦርነት እና ቀጥሎም የታየው የዘገየ የመቆጣጠር ስልት አሁን በአዲስ የሁቲዎች ጥቃት መፈራረሱ ተነግሯል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ቀደም ሲል የነበራትን የሁቲዎችን የመቆጣጠር ስልት እንደ ቀድሞው ተግባራዊ ማድረግ አልቻለችም፤ ይህም በክልሉ ያለውን የፀጥታ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Sa’udii Arabiyaan humnoota Huutii Yemen keessa jiran too’achuuf yaalii goote fashaluun isaa angawoota biyyattii keessattuu abbaa taayitaa biyyattii Mohammed bin Salman irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira. Waraana waggoota hedduu fudhate booda, sa’udiin tasgabbii uumuuf yaalii goote hundi amma jeeqama haaraa kanaan gufatee jira. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, tooftaan Sa’udiin Huutiiwwan ittiin tasgabbeessaa turte amma bu’aa dhabuu isaa fi biyyattiin rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa keessa akka jirtu ibsaniiru.

title: Yemeni army says 200 Houthis killed, wounded in clashes in Taiz
english: The Yemeni military reported that over 200 Houthi fighters were either killed or wounded during intense battles in Taiz province. These confrontations occurred across several fronts, supported by airstrikes that targeted enemy armored vehicles and military positions. The clashes mark a significant escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የየመን ጦር በታይዝ ግዛት በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ ግጭት ከ200 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። ውጊያው በተለያዩ የጦር ግንባሮች የተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የአየር ኃይል ድጋፍም በጠላት ተሽከርካሪዎችና በጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa biyya Yemen Taiz keessatti waraana cimaa taasifameen lolaan Houthi 200 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu fi madaa'uu ibseera. Loli kun dirree waraanaa garaagaraa irratti kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, xiyyaarri waraanaas konkolaataa fi iddoo lolaa isaanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hammeesseera.

title: Russia attack hits Kyiv after reported intelligence lapse
english: Russian forces launched a significant aerial assault on Kyiv, specifically targeting the city's energy infrastructure. The strikes resulted in power outages for over 500,000 residents. President Zelenskyy noted that Ukraine did not receive any prior intelligence warnings from its allies regarding the impending attack.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ የኃይል ማመንጫ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቱ ከግማሽ ሚሊዮን በላይ ለሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መቋረጥ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ በበኩላቸው፣ ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት ከምዕራባውያን አጋሮቻቸው ምንም ዓይነት የቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ መረጃ እንዳልደረሳቸው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiyiv keessatti bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni walakkaa miliyoonaa ol ta'an ibsaa malee hafeera. Preezdaantiin Yuukreen akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kana ilaalchisee hiriyyoonni isaanii gargaarsa odeeffannoo dursaa tokko illee isaaniif hin kennine.

title: Barcola scores hat-trick as Liverpool hit LASK for six
english: Bradley Barcola silenced his critics by scoring his first three goals for Liverpool during a high-scoring 6-3 Champions League victory over LASK. The forward, who recently moved from Paris Saint-Germain, led the team to success alongside other scorers like Ronald Araujo, Jeremie Frimpong, and Lewis Koumas. This win keeps Liverpool undefeated in the tournament and serves as a major confidence boost for manager Andoni Iraola's squad.

title: Spanish NGO halts Mediterranean rescue operations, citing fuel prices
english: A Spanish humanitarian organization has suspended its migrant rescue missions in the Mediterranean Sea until next year because of the significant increase in fuel prices. The group has shifted its focus to Spanish coastal waters and is seeking public donations to manage these higher operational costs. This development highlights the ongoing challenges for rescue groups operating along one of the world's most perilous migration routes.

oromo: Dhaabbanni gargaarsa namoomaa kan Ispeen tokko gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaatiin walqabatee, hojii godaantota galaana Meditiraaniyaan irraa baraaruu hanga waggaa dhufuutti dhaabeera. Dhaabbatichi hojii isaa gara qarqara galaana Ispeenitti kan jijjiirrate yoo ta'u, baasii olka'aa kana dandamachuuf deeggarsa ummataa gaafachaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun haala nageenyaa daran cimaa ta'e karaa godaantotaa kana irratti hojii gargaarsa namoomaa hojjechuun hangam ulfaataa akka ta'e kan mul'isu dha.

title: How will a new alliance affect the conflict in eastern DRC?
english: Former Democratic Republic of the Congo President Joseph Kabila has formed a new political and military coalition with M23 rebel forces in the eastern part of the country. This alliance aims to challenge the current government in Kinshasa, raising concerns about a potential increase in regional violence. Experts fear that this partnership could further destabilize an area already struggling with failed peace initiatives and ongoing armed conflict.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የቀድሞ ፕሬዚዳንት ጆሴፍ ካቢላ በሀገሪቱ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል ከሚንቀሳቀሱት የኤም 23 አማፂያን ጋር አዲስ የፖለቲካ እና የውትድርና ጥምረት መስርተዋል። ይህ ጥምረት በኪንሻሳ ያለውን መንግስት ለመቃወም ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት የበለጠ ሊያባብሰው ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ የሰላም ስምምነቶች ውጤታማ ባለመሆናቸው፣ አዲሱ ህብረት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት ወደ ተባባሰ ደረጃ ሊወስድ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Preezidaantii duraanii Rippaablika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo Joozeef Kaabilaa, humnoota finxaaleyyii M23 waliin ta'uun gamtaa siyaasaa fi waraanaa haaraa baha biyyattii keessatti ijaarrataniiru. Gamtaan kun mootummaa Kinshasaa jiru mormuuf kan kaayyeffate yoo ta'u, kunis naannichatti waraanni akka hammatu sodaa uumee jira. Carraaqqiin nagaa kanaan dura godhaman gufachuun isaa fi tumsi kun uumamuu isaa wal qabatee, naannichi gara fuulduraatti rakkoo nageenyaa hamaa keessa seenuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: US lifts sanctions on Venezuela’s top legislator
english: The United States government has officially removed Venezuelan legislative leader Jorge Rodriguez from its sanctions list. This decision is part of a broader diplomatic effort involving energy agreements and political negotiations between the two nations. It follows similar recent actions where the U.S. lifted restrictions on other Venezuelan officials and state institutions as part of a transition plan.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት የቬንዙዌላውን የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት አፈ ጉባኤ ጆርጅ ሮድሪጌዝን ከማዕቀብ ዝርዝሩ ውስጥ በይፋ አስወግዷል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ካለው የኢነርጂ ስምምነት እና የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ድርድር ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። አሜሪካ ቀደም ሲል በሌሎች የቬንዙዌላ ባለሥልጣናት እና የመንግሥት ተቋማት ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ በማንሳት የፖለቲካ ሽግግር ለማምጣት እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganaa seera baastuun biyya Venezuweelaa Jorge Rodrigiiz tarree sanada irraa kaaseera. Ameerikaan kanaan dura aangawoota fi dhaabbilee mootummaa Venezuweelaa kan biroo irra sanada kaa'ee ture kaasuun, ce'umsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti gahee qabaachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirti.

title: US says it destroyed Iranian-affiliated vessel last week
english: The United States military confirmed it sank a ship linked to Iran in the Gulf of Oman on October 6. Officials stated the vessel was being used to monitor and identify American naval ships in the region. Before the boat was destroyed, all crew members were evacuated safely and are currently in the process of being sent home.

Markabichi osoo hin barbadaa'in dura namoonni hundi nagaan kan baafaman yoo ta'u, amma gara biyyatti deebisuuf qophiin taasifamaa jira.

title: Gaza officials say Israeli strikes kill four
english: Israeli military strikes in Gaza resulted in the deaths of four individuals on Wednesday. Two men were killed following an attack on a vehicle near Khan Younis, while another strike on an apartment complex in Gaza City claimed the lives of two others, including a woman. These incidents occur shortly after the anniversary of a ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በጋዛ አራት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በካን ዩኒስ አቅራቢያ በተሽከርካሪ ላይ በተሰነዘረ ጥቃት ሁለት ወጣቶች ሲገደሉ፣ በጋዛ ከተማ ደግሞ በአንድ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ላይ በተፈጸመ ሌላ ጥቃት አንዲት ሴትን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎች ሞተዋል። ይህ ሁነት የተከሰተው በአሜሪካ አሸማጋይነት የተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አመታዊ በዓል ከተከበረ ጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው።

Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taatee irratti waliif galame sana booda guyyoota muraasa keessatti.

title: Azerbaijan's hijab ban sparks outrage in Turkey as women recall past restrictions
english: Recent school dress code changes in Azerbaijan have led to the banning of hijabs in classrooms, causing significant public protests and dozens of arrests. This situation has triggered widespread criticism in Turkey, where many citizens are drawing parallels to their own country's historical struggle with religious clothing restrictions. Azerbaijani officials claim these measures are essential to maintain secular education, while critics argue the policy unfairly discriminates against students and teachers based on their religious beliefs.
amharic: በአዘርባጃን በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ የሂጃብ (የራስ መሸፈኛ) አጠቃቀም ላይ የተጣለው ክልከላ በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞና እስር አስከትሏል። ይህ ክስተት በቱርክ ህዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ትችት የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ብዙዎች ጉዳዩን ከቱርክ ታሪካዊ የሂጃብ ክልከላ ትግል ጋር በማነፃፀር እያስታወሱት ነው። የአዘርባጃን ባለስልጣናት ህጉ የዓለማዊ ትምህርት ስርአትን ለማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ ነው ሲሉ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን በሃይማኖታዊ ልብስ ምክንያት ተማሪዎችና መምህራን መገለላቸው ኢ-ፍትሃዊ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Murtii haaraan biyya Azarbaajaan keessatti manneen barnootaa keessatti haguuggii mataa (hijab) dhorke mormii guddaa fi hidhaa namoota hedduu hordofsiiseera. Mootummaan Azarbaajaan tarkaanfichi barnoota secular ta'e kabachiisuuf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu uffata amantii isaaniitiin barnoota irraa dhorkamuun mirga namaa sarbuu akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Sally Rooney books cannot be sold in UK amid Palestine Action ban, says publisher
english: Publisher Faber has stopped selling books by Irish author Sally Rooney in the UK due to legal restrictions involving her support for Palestine Action. The UK government classified this group as a terrorist organization, making it illegal for the publisher to transfer earnings to the author. Both Rooney and her publisher agreed to halt sales to avoid committing criminal offenses under current British law.
amharic: የአየርላንዳዊቷ ጸሐፊ ሳሊ ሩኒ መጻሕፍት ከፓለስታይን አክሽን ጋር ባላት ግንኙነት ምክንያት በዩኬ ውስጥ እንዳይሸጡ ተወስኗል። የዩኬ መንግሥት ቡድኑን እንደ አሸባሪ በመፈረጁ፣ አሳታሚው ፋበር ለጸሐፊዋ የሽያጭ ገቢን መክፈል ሕገ-ወጥ ሆኖባቸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት ሳሊ ሩኒ እና አሳታሚዋ ሕግ ላለመተላለፍ ሲሉ በዩኬ ውስጥ መጻሕፍትን ማሰራጨት ለማቆም ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Barreessituun lammii Ayirlandii Sally Rooney deggersa isheen garee 'Palestine Action' jedhamuuf qabduun walqabatee, kitaabonni ishee biyya UK keessatti akka hin gurguramne murtaa'eera. Mootummaan UK garee kana dhaabbata shororkeessaa jechuun waan moggaaseef, maxxansiin ishee Faaber galii gurgurtaa ishee erguun seeraan alaa ta'eera. title: Yemen's Houthis say they targeted Riyadh airport with ballistic missile
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have claimed responsibility for launching a ballistic missile at the international airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda Mikhmaas keessatti masjiida tokko gubanii qabeenya miidhaniru, akkasumas barreeffamoota jibbaa ibsan ganama kana keessa kaa'aniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, qotee bulaan Beetaa keessatti mucaa xinnaa tokko irratti miidhaa kan geessisan yoo ta'u, waraanni Israa'el immoo naannoo weest Baank keessatti weerara gaggeessuun namoota hedduu hidhaniiru. Gochi kun, keessattuu yeroo haamaa ejersaa kanatti qotee bulaa Palastinootaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuufi miidhaa guddachaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israeli plan to reopen settler ‘Route 463’ threatens to isolate Ramallah
english: The Israeli military plans to reopen Route 463 for settler traffic, a move that would disconnect several Palestinian villages and neighborhoods in the West Bank. This 10-kilometer road would physically fragment the Ramallah and el-Bireh governorate, forcing tens of thousands of local residents onto severely congested alternative routes. Palestinian officials and organizations argue that this project is part of a broader strategy to disrupt Palestinian land continuity and support illegal settlement expansion.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን ራውት 463 የተሰኘውን መንገድ ለሰፋሪዎች እንደገና ለመክፈት አቅዷል። ይህ እርምጃ በርካታ የፍልስጤም መንደሮችን የሚለይ እና የራማላህ ግዛትን ለሁለት የሚከፍል በመሆኑ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በጣም በተጨናነቁ ሌሎች መንገዶችን ለመጠቀም ይገደዳሉ። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ዕቅድ የአካባቢውን የፍልስጤም ሰፈራዎች ትስስር ለማፍረስ እና ሕገ-ወጥ የሰፈራ መስፋፋትን ለማገዝ ታቅዶ የተዘጋጀ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el daandii 'Route 463' jedhamu kan mandara keessa jiran warra Israa'el qofaaf akka banu karoorfateera. Tarkaanfiin kun gandoota Filisxeemii hedduu kan addaan baasuufi naannoo Ramallah bakka lamatti kan hiru waan ta'eef, jireenya ummata naannichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisa. Kana irraa kan ka'e, lammiileen Filisxeemii kumni hedduun daandiiwwan biraa cufaa ta'an fayyadamuuf dirqamu. Itti gaafatamtoonni Filisxeemii, karoorri kun lafa Filisxeemii walitti hidhachuu isaa mancaasuufi babal'ina qe'ee seeraan alaa gargaaruuf kan qophaaye dha jedhanii mormaa jiru.

title: Sudan cannot afford to dismiss a chance for dialogue
english: Sudan is currently facing a devastating, multi-year conflict that cannot be resolved through military action alone. A new initiative led by Sudanese public figures aims to create a path for national dialogue, though it faces criticism from various groups who fear it may favor existing military leadership. While these concerns about neutrality are valid, it is vital to keep this diplomatic channel open rather than rejecting it, as the country desperately needs a political solution to end the suffering.
amharic: ሱዳን ለብዙ ዓመታት በቆየው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ትገኛለች፣ ይህንም ችግር በወታደራዊ ኃይል ብቻ መፍታት አይቻልም። የሱዳን ታዋቂ ግለሰቦች ያቋቋሙት አዲስ የውይይት መድረክ በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ቢሞክርም፣ በወታደራዊ አገዛዝ ተጽዕኖ ስር ይወድቃል በሚል አንዳንድ ወገኖች ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ስጋቶች ተገቢ ቢሆኑም፣ የሀገሪቱን ሰላም ለማምጣት ማንኛውንም የድርድር ሙከራ ሳይንቁ እድል መስጠት አስፈላጊ ነው።
oromo: Sudaan waggoota hedduuf waraana keessa turte furmaata waraana qofaan argachuu hin dandeessu. Namootni bebbeekamoon Sudaan marii biyyaaleessaa jalqabuuf yaaliin godhanis, humnoota waraanaatiin dhiibbaa irra jiraachuu danda'a soda jedhuun mormiin irratti ka'eera. Haata'u malee, sodaan kun dhugaa ta'us, rakkoo biyyattii furuuf marii kamiyyuu utuu hin tuffatin carraa kennuun barbaachisaadha.

title: From Cairo to Tokyo: Can you guess these twin cities?
english: The London borough of Hackney is currently considering ending its long-standing sister-city partnership with Haifa, Israel, due to human rights concerns regarding the conflict in Gaza. City twinning, which originated after World War II to foster international peace and cultural exchange, is increasingly being used as a tool for local governments to make symbolic political statements. Hackney council officials are reviewing public feedback before making a final decision on whether to officially dissolve this decades-old relationship.
amharic: የለንደን አስተዳደር አካል የሆነው ሃክኒ፣ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ምክንያት በእስራኤል ከተማ ከምትገኘው ሃይፋ ጋር ያለውን የረጅም ጊዜ የከተማ ትስስር ለማቋረጥ እየመከረ ነው። ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት በኋላ ለሰላም እና ለባህል ልውውጥ የተጀመረው ይህ የከተማ ትስስር፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የአካባቢ አስተዳደሮች የፖለቲካ አቋማቸውን የሚገልጹበት መንገድ ሆኗል። የሃክኒ ምክር ቤት ውሳኔውን ከማሳለፉ በፊት የህዝብ አስተያየቶችን በመሰብሰብ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi magaalaa Landan kan ta'e Hackney, waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee magaalaa Israa'el Haifa waliin walitti dhufeenya isaan qaban xumuruuf mari'achaa jira. Walitti dhufeenyi magaaloolee gartuuwwan lamaa, waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda nagaa fi waljijjiirraa aadaa cimsuuf kan eegalame yoo ta'u, amma garuu mootummoonni naannoo ejjennoo siyaasaa ibsachuuf itti fayyadamaa jiru. Bulchiinsi Hackney murtoo dhumaa dabarsuu dura yaada ummataa walitti qabaa jira.

title: Man City deserve to keep trophies despite charges, says PSG’s Luis Enrique
english: Paris Saint-Germain manager Luis Enrique has expressed his support for Manchester City, stating that the club deserves to keep their trophies despite facing serious charges for financial rule violations. While acknowledging that authorities must handle the legal process, Enrique praised the team's on-field performance and hopes they avoid severe sanctions like being stripped of their titles. Manchester City, who deny any wrongdoing, currently face potential penalties including point deductions or relegation as they prepare to host PSG in the Champions League.
amharic: የፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜኑ አሰልጣኝ ሉዊስ ኤንሪኬ፣ ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በገንዘብ ነክ ህጎች ጥሰት ክስ ቢቀርብበትም ያሸነፋቸውን ዋንጫዎች እንደሚያስጠብቅ አስተያየት ሰጥተዋል። ህጋዊ ሂደቱ በባለሙያዎች መታየት እንዳለበት የገለጹት አሰልጣኙ፣ ቡድኑ በሜዳ ላይ ባሳየው ብቃት ዋንጫዎቹን ይገባዋል ብለዋል። ማንቸስተር ሲቲ የቀረበበትን ክስ ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታቸውን ከፒኤስጂ ጋር ከማድረጋቸው በፊት የውሳኔውን መጠበቅ እንደሚያስፈልግ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Paaris Saint-Geermaan Luwiis Enriikee, kilabni Maanchistar Siitii seera maallaqaa cabseera jedhamee himatamee kan jiru ta’us, waancaa inni kanaan dura injifate akka hin dhabne dubbataniiru. Enriikeen adeemsi seeraa bakka isaa eeguu akka qabu kan ibsan yoo ta’u, yoo tapha qofa ilaalle garuu, kilabichi waancaa kana injifachuu akka qabu ibsaniiru. Maanchistar Siitii himata irratti dhihaate kana haaluun apiluu kan dhiyeesse yoo ta’u, gaaffiin adabbii kilabichaatti aggaammatee jiru kun kan itti fufu ta’a.

title: Ukrainian drones strike more than 100km into Russian territory
english: Ukrainian drones successfully launched an attack deep inside Russian territory, reaching the Saratov region over 100 kilometers from the border. Local authorities confirmed that the strikes resulted in the death of one person and caused significant property damage to residential homes. This incident marks a notable expansion of the reach of Ukrainian aerial operations.
amharic: የዩክሬን ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች (ድሮኖች) ከድንበር በዘለለ ከ100 ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ርቀት ላይ በሚገኘው የሩሲያ ሳራቶቭ ክልል ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የክልሉ አስተዳደር ጥቃቱ የአንድ ሰው ሕይወት ማለፉን እና በበርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬን የአየር ጥቃት የመድረሻ አቅም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Xiyyaawwan eenyu-iyyuu hin fe'in (dronii) kan Yukreen, daangaa irraa gara keessa biyya Raashiyaatti kiilomeetira 100 ol fagaatee naannoo Saaraatoovitti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa akka ibsetti, haleellaa kanaan namni tokko yoo du'u, manneen jireenyaa hedduunis manca'aniiru. Gochi kun humnoonni Yukreen meeshaalee waraana isaanii gadi fageenyaan gara biyya Raashiyaatti gadi dhiisuu akka danda'an kan agarsiisuudha.

title: China and North Korea to open New Yalu River Bridge, state media reports
english: China and North Korea are set to officially open the New Yalu River Bridge this Thursday, ending a long delay that started when North Korea left its section unfinished due to international sanctions. While the bridge was intended to increase trade, its opening follows a period of strained relations and shifting diplomatic priorities for Pyongyang. Experts suggest this move reflects the evolving geopolitical dynamics between North Korea, China, and Russia.
amharic: ቻይና እና ሰሜን ኮሪያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን አዲስ የያሉ ወንዝ ድልድይ በዚህ ሐሙስ በይፋ እንደሚከፍቱ አስታውቀዋል። የሰሜን ኮሪያ የኑክሌር ሙከራዎችን ተከትሎ በተጣለው ማዕቀብ ምክንያት ግንባታው ለዓመታት ተቋርጦ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን የሁለቱ አገራት የንግድ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ይከፈታል። ይህ የድልድይ መከፈት በሰሜን ኮሪያ፣ በቻይና እና በሩሲያ መካከል እየተቀያየረ ያለውን የፖለቲካ እና የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት የሚያሳይ ነው ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Chaayinaan fi Kooreen Kaabaa gadoojjii laga Yaaluu kan waggoota dheeraaf osoo hin xumuramin ture guyyaa Kamisa dhufu kana akka banan beekameera. Gadoojjiin kun erga mootummaan Kooriyaa Kaabaa qormaata niwukilaraa gaggeessee fi adabbii idil-addunyaa irratti dabarfamee booda dhaabbatee ture. Banamuun gadoojjii kanaa guddina daldalaa jidduu biyyoota lamaanii kan akeekkate yoo ta'u, jijjiirama siyaasaa fi hariiroo diippiloomaasii biyyoota lamaanii fi Raashiyaa gidduu jiru kan calaqqisu dha.

title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
english: A Ukrainian man named Serhii K has gone on trial in Germany, facing charges for his alleged role in the 2022 explosions that destroyed the Nord Stream gas pipelines. Prosecutors believe he worked with a team of divers to sabotage the infrastructure, which they say was intended to disrupt Russian war funding. The suspect denies these claims, and the case remains a complex and politically sensitive issue for Germany as it balances its support for Ukraine with its legal obligations.

Shakkamichi yakka kana gadi jedhee kan haale yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun hariiroo Jarmanii fi Yukreen gidduu jiru irratti rakkoo siyaasaa fi seeraa guddaa uumeera.

title: US fines Bank of America $1.2bn for money laundering, sanctions violations
english: The U.S. Treasury has penalized Bank of America over $1.2 billion for failing to follow anti-money laundering and sanctions regulations. The bank was cited for neglecting to report over $5 billion in suspicious transactions and delegating its oversight duties to third parties. Officials emphasized that these record-breaking fines serve as a warning that even major financial institutions must strictly follow national security and legal standards.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa baankiin Bank of America seera dhiqaa maallaqaa fi sanada adabbiiwwan biyyoolessaa cabsuun isaa irraan kan ka’e dolaara biliyoona 1.2 ol akka kaffalu ajajeera. Baankiichi gabaasa daldala shakkiin keessa jiru kan dolaara biliyoona 5 ol ta’u dhiyeessuu dhabuu fi itti gaafatamummaa to’annoo isaa qaama sadaffaaf dabarsuun isaa isatti fuudhameera. Qaamoleen mootummaa akka ibsanitti, adabbiin seenaa keessatti guddaa ta’e kun, dhaabbileen maallaqaa gurguddoon illee seeraa ol akka hin taane kan yaadachiisuudha.

title: Namibia battles cattle disease outbreak as EU suspends several meat imports
english: Namibia is facing a serious outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease, leading to strict livestock movement restrictions and the suspension of meat exports to the European Union. This crisis has significantly damaged local markets and small businesses, while causing meat shortages and rising prices for residents. The government is currently working to contain the spread of the virus to protect the country's vital livestock industry and restore economic stability.
amharic: ናሚቢያ በአፍ እና በአፍ በሽታ ወረርሽኝ እየተጠቃች ሲሆን ይህም የእንስሳት እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ጥብቅ ገደቦችን በመጣል ወደ አውሮፓ ህብረት የሚላከው የስጋ ምርት እንዲቋረጥ አድርጓል። ይህ ችግር በአካባቢው ገበያዎች እና በትንንሽ ነጋዴዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በነዋሪዎች ዘንድ የስጋ እጥረትና የዋጋ ጭማሪ እንዲከሰት አድርጓል። መንግስት የሀገሪቱን ዋና የገቢ ምንጭ የሆነውን የእንስሳት ሀብት ለመጠበቅ እና የኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋትን ለመመለስ የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Namibiyaan dhibee afaanifi miilaa jedhamuun rakkattee kan jirtu yoo ta'u, kunis sochiin horii akka daangeffamuufi ergaan foonii gara gamtaa Awurooppaatti godhamu akka dhaabatu taasiseera. Rakkoon kun gabaa naannoofi daldaltoota xixiqqoo irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira; akkasumas fooon akka hir'atuufi gatiin isaas akka dabalu taasiseera. Mootummaan dhibee kana to'achuufi guddina diinagdee biyyattii kan ta'e sektara horii eeguuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Israeli attacks kill one in Gaza, wound journalists in occupied West Bank
english: A recent Israeli airstrike in Gaza City resulted in one fatality and multiple injuries, while a young boy also succumbed to previous wounds. In the occupied West Bank, Israeli military actions led to additional casualties, including a wounded child and journalists affected by tear gas. These incidents highlight the ongoing violence despite the ceasefire anniversary, with reports indicating that Israeli forces have expanded their territorial control across Gaza.

oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa qilleensaatiin nam tokko yoo ajjeesu, namoonni biroo immoo madaa'aniiru; daa'imni tokkos madaa darbe kanaan lubbuun isaa darbeera. title: How podcasts became political powerhouses
english: The 2024 US election highlighted the rising influence of podcasts in shaping political discourse and reaching voters. While these platforms allow candidates to connect with audiences more directly, critics question if they encourage meaningful debate or simply help politicians avoid tough journalistic questioning. Experts are now examining whether this shift enhances democracy or merely creates echo chambers for partisan messaging.

title: Iran war live: Saudi coalition hits Houthi sites; Aramco office hit in east
english: Tensions escalated as Houthi rebels attacked a Saudi Aramco facility in Dhahran, prompting a retaliatory military response from the Saudi-led coalition against Houthi fuel targets in Yemen. President Trump claimed the rebels are intentionally disrupting energy infrastructure to manipulate oil prices ahead of U.S. elections. Both sides maintain that they are taking measures to minimize civilian harm despite the ongoing regional conflict.

Gidduu kana walitti bu'iinsa jiru keessatti, gareewwan lamaanuu miidhaa siviloota irra gahu hir'isuuf of eeggannoo gochaa akka jiran ibsaniiru.

title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
english: Pope Leo XIV underwent a successful surgical procedure at a Rome hospital to remove a portion of his right lung after being diagnosed with early-stage adenocarcinoma. The growth was discovered during routine medical examinations, and the surgery was performed to ensure the cancer was fully removed. The 71-year-old leader is now recovering in his hospital room, and his public schedule has been paused until October 20th to allow for his recuperation.
